author: Prashan76506990
text: Reported a reflected XSS in Laravel's debug error page: a crafted URL breaks out of a JS context string, giving full JavaScript execution. Confirmed unpatched on 12.x and 13.x (tested on 13.39.0).

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-119977 (CVSS 8.1): Unauthenticated RCE in WordPress core updater via race condition, actively exploited in the wild and added to CISA KEV on November 3, 2026. Fixed in WordPress 7.1.4.

author: RohanBhanotAI
text: Linux kernel CVE-2026-98432, CVSS 9.8, remote root, no login needed. Anthropic's AI found the path. ~2.1 million MPTCP-facing servers already being scanned. Ubuntu still shipping the patch late.

author: StartupHakk
text: Anthropic says Claude developed a working remote root exploit for Linux vulnerability CVE-2026-98432 (CVSS 9.8). No credentials required on vulnerable servers with Multipath TCP listeners. The exploit isn't public.

author: notCVE
text: ACTIVELY EXPLOITED, added to CISA KEV 2026-11-04: CVE-2024-27834 Apple Multiple Products Improper Authentication Vulnerability (pointer authentication bypass). 1 public exploit.

author: LifeboatHQ
text: CISA Adds Actively Exploited GitLab RCE and Cisco Firewall DoS Flaws to KEV.

author: CyfirmaR
text: PHP2Shell is being actively exploited. CVE-2026-109618 + CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS 9.2) = unauthenticated RCE in PHP core. Updating your CMS does NOT fix it; the flaw is in PHP itself. Attribution: DPRK/Lazarus-nexus, 216-host target list captured.

author: helpnetsecurity
text: Patched Zyxel GS1900 switches remained open to in-the-wild exploit (CVE-2026-107441), per Binarly and GreyNoise.

author: Valitron_AB
text: YOOtheme Pro CVE-2026-102785 (CVSS 4.0 10.0): unauthenticated RCE via image handler (5.0.0-5.0.52, fixed in 5.0.53). Unit 42 has seen exploitation in the wild. Not in CISA KEV.

author: veenodetech
text: Microsoft's October 2026 Patch Tuesday fixed ~1,411 flaws; one exploited in real attacks: CVE-2026-96951, a Windows Shell Mark of the Web bypass.

author: markgadala
text: Node.js announces upcoming security patches for high-severity vulnerabilities across three major versions.

author: stretchcloud
text: OpenAI says an agent pipeline run against the Linux kernel for 30 hours in October produced 2,308 candidate findings, 1,724 reproduced in a sandbox, 948 working root exploits with patches, about $1,279 each.

author: moftahlmabry
text: 948 ways to get root on Linux, found by AI in one run. OpenAI's pipeline running an unreleased cyber model reproduced 1,724 Linux kernel bugs and built 948 distinct LPE exploits, each with a candidate patch, for $1.21M in API credits.

author: AgentFieldKit
text: Strands Agents Tools before 0.8.6 (CVE-2026-115415, AWS): prompt injection could get the environment tool to return env vars unmasked, including API keys. Upgrade and rotate keys.

author: ZeroAgencyAI
text: Coding agents may install Anthropic's archived GitHub/Puppeteer MCP servers from memory; no fixes coming. Puppeteer's MCP server has an RCE via prompt injection.

author: baoge808
text: 98% of coding-agent sessions install archived, vulnerable MCP servers on their own (Glow Labs, MCPhantom). 17.3M npm downloads of packages with known RCE via prompt injection.

author: CVEnew
text: CVE-2026-63655 tsParticles: prior to 4.3.1, the HTTP mode of @tsparticles/mcp-server accepts unauthenticated requests.

author: CVEnew
text: CVE-2026-76892 tsParticles: prior to 4.3.1, the HTTP mode of @tsparticles/mcp-server calls JSON.parse on untrusted input.

author: eyalestrin
text: CVE-2026-116635 - Path traversal in the deployment status component of the AWS Serverless MCP Server.

author: theomlondhe
text: Two CVSS 9.6 RCEs hit MCP Inspector on Oct 21 (OAuth callback ran local commands). GitHub advisory API still 404s both GHSAs, OSV returns nothing, npm audit misses them. Fixed in 1.0.3 / 2.12.0.

author: for_N5R1
text: EchoLeak breakdown: zero-click prompt injection in Microsoft 365 Copilot chains four defense failures, from a mail that evades the injection filter to retrieval pulling it into context for data exfiltration.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Malicious versions of the Claude Code VS Code extension were distributed through Cursor's marketplace for 11 hours, exposing up to 5,000 developers to a supply chain attack with reconnaissance, persistence, and SSH backdoor capabilities.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: Supply-chain attack targeting OpenAI Codex users via a malicious GitHub configuration bundle: no executable payload, just natural-language prompt injection hijacking the agent's global system prompt.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: MSP-linked threat actor authenticates as trusted Azure apps, bypassing MFA, to harvest credentials across multiple customer tenants; campaign first observed November 1, 2026.

author: JNitterauer
text: Todyl and Huntress: an automated operator is replaying stolen credentials to reach MSP Microsoft 365 and Azure tenants and their downstream clients.

author: liuziqi529
text: Warp disclosed a vendor breach that may expose AI agent logs (~1% of users). Rotate keys the agent used.

author: klm10000
text: Nvidia rotated Brev SSH keys after a breach.

author: ICPLEGEND1966
text: Binance and Deribit revoked API keys connected to SignalPlus following a potential security issue; Binance says customer funds are safe.

author: ICPLEGEND1966
text: NTT DOCOMO detected unauthorised external access affecting servers supporting DOCOMO Online Shop and My docomo.

author: ndgmlondon
text: A breach at OpenCode's Console exposed stored OpenAI, Anthropic and Google keys; resulting bills ranged from $16 to $3,000.

author: infrastack_ai
text: 35 malicious packages caught in the last 24 hours: 32 on npm, 3 on PyPI, including @pubngo-stack/help-browser, @cdmbase/wiki-browser, @adminide-stack/forms-core, cdeops.

author: Dave_Joe_9377
text: The PC launcher for Goddess of Victory: NIKKE is suspected of spreading malware enabling remote control, per Korean outlets.

author: XBToshi
text: GitBook incident: attackers compromised Web3 project documentation, a supply-chain vector bypassing audited contracts and cold storage.

author: dd_pwnd
text: Google warns of LLMjacking: stolen cloud API keys used to run AI accounts; one company hit for $100,000 in a single day.

author: mhoungbo
text: October 2026 compromises: PHP, Railway, OpenCode, Binance, Polymarket, GitHub Actions, SoftBank, Cursor marketplace, Coinbase vendor, Fireworks AI, LiteLLM, Capcom, npm packages, TiDB Cloud, Warp's vendor.
